title: Order Management
seo: Etsy order management and shipping support
meta: Keep Etsy orders moving: tracking, labels, delivery issues and buyer updates handled in your shop. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Etsy order management, from sale to delivery
overview: We work through your open Etsy orders with you: confirm the details, buy shipping labels using your own Etsy account, upload tracking and message buyers about delays. We also write a simple routine for new orders, custom items and delivery problems, so nothing slips. Missing parcels and cases are handled in line with Etsy's rules. This is a fixed sprint, and ongoing daily handling is quoted separately.

faq: Can you buy shipping labels for me?
Yes, if you give shop manager access and keep funds on your own payment method. Labels are bought with your Etsy account and your postage rates. We never hold or move your money.
Yes, politely and in your name, using wording you approve. We follow Etsy's rules on keeping messages inside Etsy, and we never ask a buyer to move the sale outside the platform.
What if a parcel is lost?
We check tracking, message the buyer with a clear update and, if needed, guide the case with Etsy's rules in mind. Refund decisions stay with you.
How many orders can you do in the sprint?
The number in each package: up to 60 in Standard and 150 in Premium. If your shop sells more than that, we agree what to include before we start, and quote a monthly plan for steady handling.
